summary.en: I developed a Filimo clone as my first project using JavaScript. It features a fully responsive home page, built with Tailwind CSS, JSON Server for API integration, and Axios for data fetching.

description.en: In this project, I created a Filimo clone focusing on the home page. I used vanilla JavaScript with modern ES6+ features like arrow functions, template literals, and destructuring to enhance code readability and efficiency. JSON Server was integrated as a mock API for dynamic data handling, while Axios facilitated smooth data fetching. The UI is styled with Tailwind CSS, ensuring a clean, fully responsive design across all devices. This project helped me strengthen my core JavaScript skills, API integration, and responsive web design techniques.
